text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Nakayama Kinen, Air Groove 
came to cheer Duramente on.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove said she cannot help worrying too much, 
still picturing Duramente as the child she once was.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Duramente promised that today's run 
would paint over that picture.
